title: Email marketing for course creators and coaches
description: Send broadcasts and automated sequences to the learners and subscribers in your school. Tag, segment and write emails in a visual editor, all built in.

settings.title: Email your audience *without another tool*
settings.description: Everyone who signs up or buys becomes a contact. Tag and segment them, then send one-off broadcasts or automated sequences from the same school.
settings.smallPrint: Marketing emails start once you are on a paid plan.

settings.title: From contact to inbox
settings.description: Contacts, audiences and emails live next to your courses and sales.

items.title: Contacts
items.description: Learners, customers and newsletter signups are added on their own. See who is subscribed, a learner or newsletter only.

items.title: Tags
items.description: Label contacts, rename a tag everywhere at once, and see which broadcasts and sequences use it.

items.title: Segments
items.description: Filter by email, tag, subscription, product, community, last active or signup date, then save the filter to reuse.

items.title: Broadcasts
items.description: Send a one-time email now or schedule it in your own time zone. Send a test to up to 5 addresses first.

items.title: Sequences
items.description: Emails that send themselves after a trigger, with a wait you set between each one.

items.title: Templates
items.description: Start from a built-in layout or save your own, so every email shares the same look.

settings.title: Automate with *sequences*
settings.body:
A sequence starts when something happens. Pick a trigger and set who can enter and who is excluded.

- A new contact subscribes
- A tag is added or removed
- A learner gets access to a product, or any product
- A learner joins or leaves the community

Each email waits a number of days, and can add or remove a tag when it is sent, so you can see who has received it.

[How sequences work](/docs/marketing/sequences)

settings.title: Write once in *one editor*
settings.body:
The same visual editor is used for broadcasts, sequence emails and templates. Build emails from text, image, link, separator and footer blocks, and see a live preview.

Insert merge tags such as the subscriber's name by typing two curly brackets. Built-in templates cover announcements, newsletters, welcome emails and product promotions.

[Email editor guide](/docs/marketing/email-editor)

settings.title: Built for consent
settings.description: Only people who opted in get your marketing emails.

items.title: Subscribed contacts only
items.description: Broadcasts and sequences reach only subscribed contacts who match the audience.

items.title: Unsubscribe link and address
items.description: Every marketing email carries a managed footer with your postal address and an unsubscribe link.

items.title: Receipts still arrive
items.description: Sign-in codes and purchase receipts reach contacts even when they unsubscribe from marketing.

items.question: What do I need before I send my first email?
items.answer: A postal address in Marketing settings. Until you save one, you can't send a broadcast or activate a sequence.

items.question: Can I send marketing emails during the free trial?
items.answer: No. Learners still get sign-in codes, receipts and access emails during the trial. Broadcasts and sequences start once you are on a paid plan.

items.question: How many emails can I send?
items.answer: Pro includes 10,000 marketing emails a month and Business includes 50,000. When you self-host, you bring your own email service.

items.question: Can I add contacts by hand?
items.answer: Contacts are created when someone registers, gets access to a product or signs up through a newsletter form. You can't add one by hand from the Contacts screen.

items.question: Can I see how a broadcast performed?
items.answer: Yes. Once a broadcast is sending or sent, a Performance card shows emails sent, the open rate and the click-through rate.
